text: {"name":"bt_conn_get_state","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Returns an encoded non-zero BT connection state for a valid connection index when its active/state flag is set, or 0 when the context is unused or inactive.","subsystem":"bt","var_renames":{"a1":"conn_idx","v1":"conn_ctx","result":"state_flag"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":113,"meaning":"invalid/free sentinel, 0xFF when the connection context is unused"},{"offset":132,"meaning":"connection active/state flag; nonzero selects the encoded return state"},{"offset":136,"meaning":"link role/type byte used to form the returned state code"}]}
